predecessor.basis_reading: read P8 wherever R7 is named as a derivation basis; operatives identical

sessions.sessions_of_this_registration: every derivation-kind session opened after pins.ledger_head_pin_at_first_window
sessions.windows_of_this_registration: every session of this registration that is not a null session

null_session.definition: a terminal session of this registration in which no slot has a finalized ledger row (no capture was attempted; every declared slot is unused)
null_session.decided_by: the issuer, from the ledger; never from the operator's naming
null_session.counts_toward: nothing: not counted, valid, members, n, max_counting_windows, max_battery_replacement_windows or max_windows_total; not read by STOP-CADENCE or STOP-FUTILITY; not an adverse window
null_session.listed_in_r9_record: by session id and abort reason, with no slot entries
null_session.source: D-182 (a zero-capture refusal is not a window and licenses one successor); erratum REV6-25G83-01-E1 F4

clean_dwell.timeout_s: ceil(min(2700, remaining derivation start budget in seconds))
clean_dwell.subprocess_timeout_s: min(2700, remaining derivation start budget in seconds)
clean_dwell.on_timeout: the window does not start; the script exits 1 at its timeout
clean_dwell.named_daemon_match: anywhere in a ps aux line, case-insensitive
clean_dwell.executable_name_match: case-insensitive; remove leading whitespace and directory paths; exact name or name followed by hyphen, underscore, period or whitespace and any suffix; spaced names matched as a whole; argument text not matched
clean_dwell.load_limit_at_t0_by_night_gate: one-shot path only; not on the quiet-admission path

start_condition_evidence.record: one committed file per window: for each of conditions a to g, the evidence file path and its sha256
start_condition_evidence.required_for: every window; not for a null session
start_condition_evidence.first_session: conditions a and b are recorded as not applicable
start_condition_evidence.after_a_null_session: conditions a and b are read on the null session
issuer_refuses_if: a named evidence file is absent
a named evidence file does not match its sha256

definitions.adverse_window: battery-float window verdict is battery_float_confounded or battery_float_evidence_missing (A-R5b)
definitions.counting_window: a window that is not adverse
definitions.counted_source: the R9 record, committed and named by digest at issuance (harness report mode); the issuer does not recompute cells
definitions.member_source: ledger disposition, stored anchor outcome, and the R9 record's median frame

count_rule.evaluated: after each session's blind checks, before any B is read
count_rule.totals_are_over: counting windows so far, in ledger order

decision_order.if: this session is a null session
any stop line fired in this window

triggers_explained.source: Rev 5; A2 section 3.6 item 7, read on members

count_rule.continuation_after_stop_or_review: only by a sealed amendment to this registration; no command-line ruling
count_rule.review_means: consult, cold gate or owner (D-186); never stop for good

stop_lines.fires_if: median of per-capture median native frame lengths > 150 ms
any capture stopped on the cell count
stop_lines.source: A1 R8(b), R9; cap ruling section 5 item 4

stop_lines.fires_if: any capture stopped on the wall deadline
stop_lines.source: A1 R8(b), R9; cap ruling section 5 item 4

stop_lines.fires_if: any capture whose cell search ran has cells / cap > 0.5
stop_lines.source: A1 R8(a), R9; cap ruling section 5 item 4

stop_lines.fires_if: the harness cannot report a median frame for any capture whose finalized ledger row records a digest for its raw sampler bytes (bytes missing, digest mismatch, or no readable frame)
stop_lines.consequence: review; R9 not passed; the campaign is not void by this alone; nothing issues
stop_lines.source: A1 R9 fifth clause; A1 R0(d); erratum REV6-25G83-01-E1 F3

stop_lines.applies: sessions of this registration, in ledger order
stop_lines.fires_if: a null session whose preceding session of this registration was also a null session

sampling_dependence.computed: once, by the issuer, over the members, after the last window is terminal and the R9 record is committed
sampling_dependence.K: number of counting windows that contribute at least one member

q99_within_window.s_within: sqrt( sum over windows j, sum over members i of window j, of (B_ij - m_j)^2, divided by (n - K) ), m_j the mean B of window j's members; same Decimal working precision and same presentation quantum and rounding as sample_sd_presentation_s
q99_within_window.formula: t(0.995, n - K) * s_within_presentation_s * sqrt(2), binary64, shortest round-trip decimal
q99_within_window.rule_string: prediction_p_within_window_two_draw_s = t(p, n-K) * s_within_presentation_s * sqrt(2), evaluated in binary64 and recorded as its shortest round-tripping decimal
q99_within_window.rule_string_note: recorded verbatim beside this value; the sealed TWO_DRAW_PREDICTION_RULE string says t(p, n-1) and is never used for it
q99_within_window.which_is_larger: q99_within_window > q99_plain exactly when MSB / MSW < (r^2 - 1) * (n - K) / (K - 1), r = sqrt((n - 1) / (n - K)) * t(0.995, n - K) / t(0.995, n - 1); q99_within_window / q99_plain <= r; equal when K = 1

report_only: per window: member count, median, mean and sample SD of B, start time, start-to-start interval
range of the window medians divided by S
ICC = max(0, (MSB - MSW) / (MSB + (n0 - 1) * MSW)), MSB = sum_j n_j (m_j - m)^2 / (K - 1), MSW = s_within^2, n0 = (n - sum_j n_j^2 / n) / (K - 1); not computable if K < 2

rho1 = Spearman rank correlation, average ranks for ties, over pairs (B of slot s, B of slot s+1) where both slots are members of the same window, pairs pooled over windows; with the pair count; not computable if fewer than 3 pairs
